name: DatePickerInput

props.name: datePickerType
props.description: The type of the date picker: * `simple` - Without calendar dropdown. * `single` - With calendar dropdown and single date. * `range` - With calendar dropdown and a date range.

props.name: decorator
props.description: **Experimental**: Provide a `decorator` component to be rendered inside the `DatePickerInput` component

props.name: disabled
props.description: Specify whether or not the input should be disabled

props.name: helperText
props.description: Provide text that is used alongside the control label for additional help

props.name: hideLabel
props.description: Specify if the label should be hidden

props.name: invalid
props.description: Specify whether or not the input should be invalid

props.name: invalidText
props.description: Specify the text to be rendered when the input is invalid

props.name: labelText
props.description: Provide the text that will be read by a screen reader when visiting this control

props.name: pattern
props.description: Provide a regular expression pattern string that the input value must match

props.name: readOnly
props.description: whether the DatePicker is to be readOnly

props.name: size
props.description: Specify the size of the Date Picker Input. Currently supports either `sm`, `md`, or `lg` as an option.

props.name: slug
props.description: **Experimental**: Provide a `Slug` component to be rendered inside the `DatePickerInput` component

props.name: warn
props.description: Specify whether the control is currently in warning state

props.name: warnText
props.description: Provide the text that is displayed when the control is in warning state

a11y.note: Carbon ships a11y behaviour per component; verify per screen

when_to_use: Use Carbon DatePickerInput rather than building one.
when_not_to_use: Do not restyle off-token — propose a token instead.
